email.body1:
Wilder, saw Bitsight launch Dark Web Intelligence for Supply Chains and land Leader in the Q2 2026 Forrester Wave.

A new launch plus that recognition usually means more in-market accounts in play than an enterprise team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Bitsight off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Wilder, quick follow-up for Bitsight.

A launch and analyst win expand the accounts worth chasing faster than headcount can ramp, so enterprise pipeline goes untouched and the quarter quietly leaks. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to cover it.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your enterprise book needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Bitsight reply rate likely compares to other security-ratings platforms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
